submitted.rationale: Out of 3 merit measurements, index 11 (Cu 0.48) had the highest EQE at 3.8e-4 %. The film at the CuSb2O6 composition (idx 16), which XRD shows as phase-pure trirutile, gave about zero. The Cu-rich film (idx 6) gave 4e-5 %. So the best result came from a slightly Cu-rich CuSb2O6 film with a second phase, not from either extreme.

rejected.reason: Phase-pure CuSb2O6 by XRD, but EQE was about zero or negative (-8.6e-5 %)
Cu-rich film; EQE of 4.0e-5 % was 10 times lower than idx 11
XRD shows CuSb2O6 mixed with an Sb-oxide phase. It sits on the Sb-rich side, where EQE was already near zero at idx 16. Not measured for EQE.
